title: The Goat Slide
can_do: 讲述中听懂大人的澄清问题（哪个、然后呢），给出准确的回答。

conversation_move.label: answer clarifying questions while telling a story

trigger: Child tells Teacher about the farm trip, and Teacher asks small clarifying questions along the way.
setting: A quiet reading corner at school.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: I heard you went to the farm on Saturday!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes! We saw so many animals, Teacher.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Which animal did you see first?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The goats, because their house is by the gate.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: And what did the goats do?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: One little goat climbed on its mom's back!

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: On its mom's back? Then what happened?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: It slid down and jumped off, like at the pool!

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: A pool-slide goat! What a day.

replay_cards.title: The new bike
replay_cards.setting: Child tells Teacher about riding without training wheels.
replay_cards.change: Teacher was not there and keeps asking.
replay_cards.challenge: Child answers precisely — where he rode, who held the seat at first, and how it felt.

replay_cards.title: The library visit
replay_cards.setting: Mom asks about the school library trip.
replay_cards.change: She has not heard about it yet.
replay_cards.challenge: Child answers her clarifying questions about which book he picked and why he picked it.

parent_support: 听孩子讲事后，故意问两个小问题：“最先看到的是哪个？”“后来呢？”
孩子答得笼统时提示“在哪儿、和谁”，把细节问出来。
把问答变成聊天，别让他觉得在被考。
